newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa ends subdued day lower.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa ends subdued day lower.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa ended easier after a subdued day's trading.
New York leant some strength to London in afternoon trade, but it evaporated with a bout of profit taking in New York, the trader said.
September last traded ten stg lower at 1,008 stg on volume of 328 of the total 1,245 lots.
It trailed December, which did 469 lots, in volume terms. December last traded eight stg lower at 1,044 stg.

"I think everybody's waiting for the interest rate rise," one trader said, referring to speculation about another rise in Britain's 6.75 percent interest rate on Thursday. Then they would see the effect on sterling and on the sterling cocoa market.
